privacy-policy-content: Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our CV building service.
privacy-policy-information-collection-co: We do not collect or store any personal information or CV documents generated through our service. The data you enter to create your CV is only used to generate the CV document on the backend. We do not retain any copies of the generated CV.
privacy-policy-data-security-content: We take reasonable precautions to protect your personal information. However, please note that no data transmission over the internet or electronic storage methods are 100% secure. We cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information.
privacy-policy-third-party-services-cont: We may use third-party services and tools that have their own privacy policies. We recommend reviewing the privacy policies of these third-party services to understand how they handle your personal information.
privacy-policy-changes-to-this-policy-co: We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised date.
privacy-policy-contact-us-content: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.
